comparison.objective: Lay two cables into a carrier in order and snap all twelve crossbars shut.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-object routing, non-crossing cable placement, repeated crossbar closure, and latch snapping.
comparison.success_condition: Both cables must be seated in every link in the required order, all catches latched, and cable ends routed correctly.
comparison.reason: Cable routing and repeated closure test spatial organization and latching, not releasing and extracting a terminal from a connector.
